payload.title: Editorial review follow-ups: make the journalism primary
payload.description:
From an outside review of the site that Ryan shared on 2026-11-05. The review's main point: the journalism is ahead of the website, and the site feels more like a transparent demonstration of an automated newsroom than an established publication. Keep the transparency, which is its most distinctive feature, and make the journalism unquestionably primary, with the machinery as a second layer.

The branding epic MOM-304e2f explicitly leaves these out. Each item is a proposal for Ryan to decide, not an agreed change. Other points from the review are tracked elsewhere: raw web addresses as titles (raised with Papyrus), duplicate sources (Papyrus PPY-24fdf4, not checked), concepts (Papyrus PPY-17d057), and showing confidence (Ryan decided to keep it, as five worded steps, on develop).
